common_cause: all three are the same shape: a value the run consumed arrived as a caller parameter beside a digest that did not govern it, so the verification was decorative. The fix is derivation rather than more checks -- nothing the run consumes is a parameter any more.

after.fix: membership_path is gone; the membership is derived from the verified artifact and its bytes are RE-verified at the moment of consumption, because a gate that fires before a read does not protect the read. The emitted datasets are then checked against the pinned record.

before.detail: run() verified artifacts['a_membership'] and loaded an independently supplied membership_path. A substituted file emitted 1 train pair instead of 2 and moved a regression target from pKi 7.0 to 9.0.

after.fix: feature_sources is gone. The caches come from the verified feature_binding and the reuse maps from the verified feature_resolution, whose recorded digest for each map is checked against the map's own bytes; the two artifacts are then cross-checked on entry count and stored dimension.

before.detail: FeatureSource took a caller-supplied reuse_map. Swapping two entries repointed those keys at each other's cached rows.
before.why_this_is_the_worst_case: nothing in the published record changes at all -- not the storage digests, not the coverage report, not even the emitted dataset digest, because a dataset records pairs and targets rather than vectors.

after.fix: roles is gone. The fitting roles are derived from the verified membership over exactly the rows the loader keeps, so a role cannot under-declare; the evaluation role is derived from a new pinned input, evaluation_entities; and coverage must be checked for exactly the three roles.

before.detail: roles was a caller parameter and only train and validation were required. Dropping the evaluation role skipped its coverage check entirely; declaring 1 of 2 train compounds emitted 1 pair instead of 2, the rest counted as excluded_missing_feature rather than refused.

method: each case was reproduced through seq2lead.asof.runner.run with fitting mocked and a bound input set whose every digest matched, then the runner was changed to derive what it consumes from that set. Pre-fix outcomes are measured, not inferred.
nothing_rebuilt: no feature vector was recomputed and no .npz cache or extension changed. This was a wiring correction.
question: does verifying an artifact's digest protect a run that consumes something else?
where_the_chain_terminates: expected_digests is the pinned set the published contract records. A caller who may rewrite both an artifact and its pinned digest controls the run by definition; the guarantee is that no mutation leaving the pinned set unchanged can alter what is fitted.
